verdict.rationale: Apify publishes an OpenAPI spec (confirmed live at docs.apify.com/api/openapi.json) which underlies an API reference, and general docs exist, but there's no direct evidence of an interactive reference UI with runnable/try-it examples (e.g., a Swagger/Redoc try-it console) being confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an interactive 'try it out' console, runnable code snippets in the API reference, or community confirmation of using such a feature.
